status: Joint-reviewer roster for interactive public deployment (L-D13, 2026-10-15). It names who must decide, not what they decided: human decisions live only in the database.
account_binding: Set at deploy time by an operator: RIH_GOVERNANCE_REVIEWERS=abhinav:<staff username>,devika:<staff username>. Every slot needs its own enabled staff account with the reviewer or admin role. Unset, partial, duplicated or unknown bindings count no review at all (default deny).
